contract.purpose: Apply positive staged inventory adjustments and mark each selected row.
inputs_defaults: Only explicit declaration defaults permit omission; catalog has_default_value is not used to infer T-SQL defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: NULL/nonpositive quantity and non-NULL user flag excluded. Missing date falls back to local time. Child returnNULL does not equal0 and follows failure branch; child thrown errors are not caught locally.
output_shape: PRINT and severity10 messages for loaded/error counts; child procedure messages/results may propagate.

ordered_branches.explanation: Local static read-only cursor selects requested warehouse rows with USER_DEF1 NULL and quantity>0, ordered location descending. Formats expiry/manufacture date strings and passes a long fixed/caller argument mapping to INV_AdjustInv, including adjustment type, quantity, company/item/location/warehouse/lot/LPN and attribute ID. Per-row transaction commits when child return=0, then marks staging success and updates LOCATION_INVENTORY received/date timestamp to supplied received date or local GETDATE. Inventory update matches item/location/warehouse/null-normalized lot/LPN/company but not attribute ID, so multiple attribute rows can be stamped. Nonzero child return rolls back then marks staging failure. Staging marks/date updates occur after commit and are not error-checked; no automatic retry or idempotency protection. Commented pallet logic is inactive.

program.text: declare loadInventoryCursor CURSOR LOCAL STATIC READ_ONLY FORWARD_ONLY
select item, company, location, quantity, quantity_um, status, lot,
item_description, received_date, LPN, N'<literal:1>', object_id,user_def5,user_def3,user_def4, process_stamp
and user_def1 is null and quantity > 0 -- [comment omitted]

exec @iError = INV_AdjustInv N'<literal:6>', N'<literal:7>', N'<literal:8>', N'<literal:9>', null, N'<literal:10>', N'<literal:11>', N'<literal:12>', N'<literal:13>', 0.0, @dQuantity, 0, 0, @stCompany, null,@stExpDateLot, N'<literal:14>', -- [comment omitted]
null, null, null, @stInvSts, @stItem, @stItemDescription, @stLot, @manufacturedate, @stQtyUm, null, null, null, -- [comment omitted]
null, @stLPN, @stLocation, @stWarehouse, N'<literal:15>', @user_def3, null, null, null, @user_def4, @user_def5, 0.0, 0.0, @stUserName,  null, -- [comment omitted]
update LOCATION_INVENTORY set RECEIVED_DATE = isnull(@receiveddate, getdate())
ITEM = @stItem and LOCATION = @stLocation and warehouse = @stWarehouse and isnull(lot, '<literal:18>')  = isnull(@stLot, '<literal:19>')
and isnull(LOGISTICS_UNIT, '<literal:20>') = isnull(@stLPN, '<literal:21>') and isnull(company, '<literal:22>') = isnull(@stCompany, '<literal:23>') ;
